notes.title: Patch 1.0.8
notes.content:
Introducing Attack Speed
This new feature primarily works within the Idle Mode combat system. It has zero effect on active gameplay. This stat on weapons will indicate its base swing speed. In the instance of the basic sword, that means it swings once every 7.5 seconds in Idle Mode. All other items will usually have a +/- that indicates whether it subtracts from that base speed or adds to it. So in the instance of getting the brand new full Ranger's Set of Items, your attack speed would end up being the following:
1 attack every 4.75 seconds.
(6.0 second base attack speed, - 0.25 - 0.75 - 0.25 = 4.75)

This item should allow you to farm in idle mode even faster, and prioritizing a good mix of attack speed, lifesteal, and HP5 items can lead to a really good gear farming setup.

New Items

 Ranger's Mask
 Ranger's Leather Armor
 Ranger's Leather Boots
 Speed Potion
 Ranger's Blade


Balance Changes

 All weapons have been given base attack speeds.
 Berserker's Elixir: Added -0.1 Attack Speed.
 Necklace of Furious Strikes: Added -0.35 Attack Speed.
 Gleaming Ruby Necklace: Added -0.3 Attack Speed.
 Red Bandana: Added -0.25 Attack Speed.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7.3
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where exiting the tutorial early broke multiple parts of the game.
 Fixed a bug where bosses, mobs, and characters could not move past or spawn on top of dead bosses, causing game logic issues.
 Fixed a bug where the default Unreal Engine icon shows on the taskbar.
 Rewrote the stat calculation logic to now be 100% accurate instead of only accurate sometimes.
 Fixed a bug with Defender items parenting to the incorrect socket.
 Fixed a bug with hair not reappearing when equipping certain helmet slot items.


Quality of Life

 Added a tooltip to perks.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.7
notes.content:
Bug Fixes

 Wizard's Boots no longer remove the players ankle when equipping armor other then Wizard's Robes.
 Fixed a bug with glitchy Wizard's Robe appearance.
 Added health drain mechanics for Idle Mode on The Reaper Boss Fight
 Fixed a bug where enemies would start spawning again if you entered the equipment menu during a boss fight.
 Fixed a bug where you could reactivate movement while still being in Idle mode if you accessed the equipment menu.
 Fixed a bug with stats for non-damage stats displaying incorrectly.
 Fixed a bug where certain offhand models didn't clear after being unequipped.


Balance Changes

 Reduced the amount of damage health drain mechanics do on Idle Mode as well as increased the duration between health drain attacks for both Father Alaric and The Reaper.
 Removed HP5, Lifesteal, and Critical Strike stats from Wizard's set.


New Mechanic: Soulshield
This new mechanic is intended to create value for the following stat categories: HP5, Max Health, Lifesteal, and Armor.
Simply put, excess life gain, either in the form of Lifesteal or HP5, can provide a "Soulshield" equivalent to half of your Max Health value. At the end of a boss encounter, the total value of this shield is sacrificed to Varkul, in exchange for an increased chance at gaining loot! 

New Tutorial
It's high time I finally created a tutorial for the game. It isn't as in-depth as it could be, but it should be enough to understand the basics of combat.

New Items

 New Rare Weapon: Bloodletter's Scalpel
 New Rare Offhand: Health Potion


Upcoming Changes:
The following changes are coming soon!

 New Stat: Attack Speed - This stat is exclusively for Idle Mode only and increases the rate at which your character attacks in idle mode.
 New Stat: EXP Gain - This stat is intended to work with the new Combat Level & Experience System. It will increase the total experience gained from kills & boss fights.
 New System: Combat Level & Experience - This system will allow players to level up Gideon Rageblade, assigning a point to certain stat categories with each level up. We will also introduce a new leaderboard for player levels.
 New Items: Combo Books - Bosses & Playtime generators will have a chance to drop a rare book that will add the combo to the players combo book, as well as enhance its damage output.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.6
notes.content:
I heard you loud and clear! You want new items, and you want better performance while the game is running in the background. This patch aims to deliver that, as well as some minor bug fixes! I hope you enjoy!
Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where if a boss despawned, you would get into a permanent loop of respawning bosses until a boss was killed again.
 Fixed a bug where your health would not set to your max health on starting a new run.


Performance Improvements

 Fixed a bug with UI events getting stuck in a massive queue if the game was in the background or minimized, then firing all at once when the game was maximized, causing a crash.
 Massively improved performance impact when the game is minimized or alt tabbed.
 Added options to allow auto skipping of perks & disable damage text to allow further improved performance.

New Items

 1 New Weapon
 1 New Set of Armor
 1 New Helmet
 1 New Pair of Boots
 4 New Offhands


Balance Adjustments

 Reduced the armor value by 1 and health value by 5 of Iron Armor items.

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.5.1

notes.title: Patch 1.0.5 - Introducing The Soul Furnace!
notes.content:
New Mechanic: Soul Furnace
We know you guys are tired of getting bones, bananas, and iron swords of slashing, especially after you've got insane upgrades already. Now, we've got great news. You can upgrade items you no longer consider worth it into one better item. Varkul has opened his Soul Furnace, and for the low, low price of ten items and a soul, you can upgrade it into one tier higher, getting an item you truly want!

How it Works:

 10 Common Items + 1 Soul = 1 Uncommon Item
 10 Uncommon Items + 2 Souls = 1 Rare Item
 10 Rare Items + 4 Souls = 1 Epic Item
 10 Epic Items + 8 Souls = 1 Legendary Item


New Items
We're introducing a few new items to the game to add some variety as well as make certain achievements possible to complete without running into a paywall.

 Iron Helmet
 Iron Plate Armor
 Iron Steelcaps
 Ruby Necklace
 Necklace of Strength
 Necklace of Furious Strikes
 Nature Pendant
 Gleaming Ruby Necklace


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where The Reaper would stop attacking and/or moving if interrupted.
 Fixed a bug allowing players to move with the Frozen Heart perk by toggling idle mode on and off.
 Fixed a bug where getting an item in the main menu would no longer allow you to hit the play button.
 Fixed a bug where Epic & Legendary equip achievements did not award.
 Fixed multiple missing entries to item descriptions & incorrect stats.


Balance Changes

 Adjusted Father Alaric's base HP value to 75.
 Capped Kill requirements for next boss spawn to 1000.
 Reduced boss item drop rate to 35%.
 Adjusted health scaling to no longer scale off of player damage but instead how many times it has spawned. To explain this better: If you kill a boss, the next time he spawns, his health will be doubled. This will keep repeating for every spawn.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Hey everyone, patch 1.0.4 is going to be a fun one, so buckle up!
Bug Fixes

 Fix bug preventing game flow from continuing if player failed to kill boss in time limit.
 Fix bug with loadouts not always properly applying stats.
 Fix lighting issue when starting game with high quality settings(This may still be broken on some systems, please let us know.)
 Fixed bug where The Reaper melee attacks, if interrupted, would prevent his damage collider from ever turning off, dealing massive damage to the player on every movement.
 Fixed a bug where Father Alaric's swords would very rarely not despawn on death.
 Fixed a bug where The Reaper's totems would very rarely not despawn on death.


Balance Changes

 Father Alaric Health increased from 35 to 50.
 The Reaper Health increased from 50 to 100.


New Feature: Treasure Chests
We've added a couple of new items to the game as well as a new feature: The Treasure Chest.
Starting today, bosses, and the rare playtime generator will have a chance to drop a limited time treasure chest for the user. These treasure chests contain great items, sometimes even Legendary items. Chests can be unlocked with a Treasure Chest Key, which can be purchased from the shop for $0.50 USD!

New Treasure Chests will be rotated into the drop pool every month, so make sure to grab them while you still can, because it might be the last time you ever see them, and with it, the items inside them!

With the new Treasure Chests feature, we will be releasing another new feature in the next week, The Soul Furnace. The Soul Furnace allows you to take lower tier items and upgrade them into higher tier items! No more useless grays! Woohoo! We will have more details to share on that next week.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.3
Hey all! Thanks so much for all of your reporting and patience as we work out these first weekend kinks. This next patch has a handful of bug fixes, performance improvements, and quality of life changes!
Bugs

 Fixed bug with boss collision preventing player aerial attacks.

Drop Rate Changes

notes.title: Too Angry To Die Released! - V1.0.1 Bug Fix & Plans for the future!
notes.content:
Woohoo!
Too Angry To Die is now live and players can begin slaying hundreds of thousands of motherflippin' zombies!

We have a night one patch headed your way, hopefully offering some much needed fixes to bugs that are frustrating as well as some quality of life improvements.

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue with leaderboards not incrementing correctly.
Fixed an issue where new loot didn't appear in current inventory unless you returned to the main menu.
Fixed an issue with The Reaper getting stuck underneath the map.
Fixed an issue with Rage Break preventing new attacks.
Fixed an issue where Combo Style Grade did not reset before boss fights began.
Fixed an issue with expiring auth tickets not reacquiring, preventing loot & high score updates from occurring correctly.


Balance Changes

Adjusted Bloodlust timing as it created unusually easy Reaper boss fight.


Quality of Life

The ESC button now pauses the game.
Added important keybinding information to the help menu.


So what can we expect next?
I have big plans for the game. Our number one intention is to keep delivering awesome content and items that keep you all engaged over the next couple of years. We have a whole story planned out that takes Gideon Rageblade throughout 4 continents, uncovering all the mysteries, violence, and awesomeness The Void has to offer.
